title: Calibration of Heart-Rate Reserve for Graded Cycle Ergometry: An Endpoint-Preserving Transfer Evaluated Against Linear Alternatives
description: Version 2.0.0 provides the reproducible CycHRR-T graded cycle-ergometry calibration study. The release includes deterministic data splits, locked-model evaluation, strong linear comparators, endpoint-exclusion and intensity-band analyses, practical 10% agreement, timing, parameter and heart-rate-anchor sensitivity analyses, bilingual manuscripts, figures and source-data tables. Analysis code is MIT licensed; redistributed third-party datasets retain their original licenses as documented in the archive.
